text: Temporary Workspaces 是面向 DSH 网页端的临时工作区插件，可一键创建带独立文件夹、工作区和会话的临时任务。它在侧边栏提供管理面板，并将设置页、会话操作和 scratch_workspace 工具接入 DSH。用户可以查看任务状态、目录占用大小、关联会话与闲置倒计时，打开目录或会话，并在完成后清理；还可配置存放根目录、目录前缀和新任务的闲置自动清理时长。适合需要为短期开发或临时任务隔离工作目录、结束后整理文件的 DSH 用户。无需 API Key 或外部账号；首次使用需设置本机存放位置。

Temporary Workspaces creates a DSH folder, workspace, and session for each task. The web sidebar shows status, idle time, folder size, and sessions, and can open or clean them up. Set a local storage root, folder prefix, and optional idle expiry for new tasks. No API key or account is needed.

临时任务创建：从管理面板或 scratch_workspace 工具创建独立目录、DSH 工作区和会话；可先配置根目录。
临时工作区管理：侧边栏面板列出任务，可查看状态、闲置倒计时、目录大小及关联会话，并打开目录或会话。
完成并清理：用户可在面板确认完成；服务检查会话与终端占用，将目录移入系统废纸篓并归档相关会话。

Throwaway workspaces for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
one click to create a folder with its own workspace and session, one panel to manage
every running one, and safe deletion when you are done — or an idle timer that does it
for you.

@s0meb0dy3/dsh-scratch-workspace README · Temporary Workspaces for DeepSeek Harness：> [!NOTE]
> Cleanup moves the folder to your system **Trash / Recycle Bin**, so a mistake is
> recoverable there. The conversation is kept and archived. Empty Trash when you are
> sure you no longer need it.

@s0meb0dy3/dsh-scratch-workspace README · Install：1. In DeepSeek Harness, open **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Install**.
2. Paste the package name:

```
   @s0meb0dy3/dsh-scratch-workspace
   ```

3. Quit DeepSeek Harness completely and reopen it, then open **Temporary workspaces**
   in the sidebar.

Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 or newer.

@s0meb0dy3/dsh-scratch-workspace README · What you get：- **One entry, two jobs** — the sidebar panel creates (`＋ Temporary task`) and manages
  (list, open, clean up) in the same place.
- **Every task at a glance** — friendly name, live state (running / terminal open),
  idle countdown, folder size, and the sessions inside it.
- **Safe deletion** — ownership and inode checks, a durable retry journal, and refusal
  while the agent or a terminal is still using the folder.
- **Optional idle expiry** — off by default; when on, it applies to new tasks only.
